correctness.rationale: For every omitted vertex, its selected neighbors are exactly selected vertices in the same or adjacent columns because P2⊠Pn has complete adjacency across neighboring columns. The exact local rule s_j<2 => s_{j-1}+s_j+s_{j+1}=2 (s0=s_{n+1}=0) forces either only 0/2 columns with internal gaps 0 or 00 and boundary gaps <=1, or the unique 11(011)^m column-count word when n=3m+2. Row orientations of all one-columns contribute 2^(2m+2). The binomial gap count and minimum multiplicities follow. Independently enumerated every labelled vertex subset for n=1..9; complete polynomials matched, including n=2 coefficient 6z^2+z^4 and n=5 coefficient 18z^4+3z^6+2z^8+z^10. Infinite n conclusion rests on combinatorial bijection.
